meanings.en: to officially declare that something, especially a marriage or contract, is no longer legally valid
meanings.exampleEn: The court decided to annul their marriage after only a few months.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme, birkaç ay sonra evliliklerini geçersiz kılmaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: the state of being unknown or of not having your name known
meanings.exampleEn: The witness spoke on condition of anonymity.
meanings.exampleTr: Tanık, kimliğinin gizli kalması koşuluyla konuştu.

meanings.en: responsible to someone or for something and having to explain your actions
meanings.exampleEn: The manager is answerable to the board for all major decisions.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür, tüm önemli kararlardan dolayı yönetim kuruluna karşı sorumludur.

meanings.en: strong feeling of dislike or opposition between people
meanings.exampleEn: There was a deep antagonism between the two rival groups.
meanings.exampleTr: İki rakip grup arasında derin bir düşmanlık vardı.

meanings.en: showing or feeling active opposition or hostility toward someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: She was openly antagonistic toward the new policy.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni politikaya karşı açıkça düşmanca bir tavır sergiliyordu.

meanings.tr: hayal kırıklığı yaratan son, düş kırıklığı, sönük bitiş
meanings.en: a disappointing end to an exciting or important series of events
meanings.exampleEn: After all the buildup, the final match was a complete anticlimax.
meanings.exampleTr: Onca beklentiden sonra final maçı tam bir hayal kırıklığıydı.

meanings.en: a strong feeling of dislike or aversion
meanings.exampleEn: He felt a deep antipathy toward all forms of bureaucracy.
meanings.exampleTr: Her türlü bürokrasiye karşı derin bir antipati duyuyordu.

meanings.en: old-fashioned and no longer suitable for modern purposes
meanings.exampleEn: The company still relies on antiquated computer systems.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket hâlâ çağdışı bilgisayar sistemlerine bağımlı.

meanings.en: at any time; whenever
meanings.exampleEn: You can call me anytime you need help.
meanings.exampleTr: Yardıma ihtiyacın olduğunda beni her zaman arayabilirsin.

meanings.en: except for; other than
meanings.exampleEn: Apart from a few minor errors, the report is excellent.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç küçük hata dışında, rapor mükemmel.

meanings.en: in addition to; as well as
meanings.exampleEn: Apart from English, she also speaks French and German.
meanings.exampleTr: İngilizceye ek olarak Fransızca ve Almanca da konuşuyor.

meanings.en: a small dish of food eaten before the main course of a meal
meanings.exampleEn: We ordered shrimp as an appetizer before dinner.
meanings.exampleTr: Akşam yemeğinden önce başlangıç olarak karides sipariş ettik.

meanings.en: the quality of being relevant or appropriate to a particular situation
meanings.exampleEn: The study questioned the applicability of the theory to real-world cases.
meanings.exampleTr: Çalışma, teorinin gerçek dünya durumlarına uygulanabilirliğini sorguladı.

meanings.en: to divide and share out something, especially money or blame, among people
meanings.exampleEn: The costs were apportioned equally among all the partners.
meanings.exampleTr: Maliyetler tüm ortaklar arasında eşit olarak paylaştırıldı.

meanings.en: the act of dividing and distributing something in proportional shares
meanings.exampleEn: The apportionment of resources caused disagreement among the departments.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaynakların paylaştırılması departmanlar arasında anlaşmazlığa yol açtı.

meanings.tr: eksper, değer biçen kişi, kıymet takdir uzmanı
meanings.en: a person whose job is to estimate the value or quality of something
meanings.exampleEn: The appraiser valued the antique painting at over a million dollars.
meanings.exampleTr: Eksper, antika tabloya bir milyon dolardan fazla değer biçti.

meanings.en: suitable or appropriate in the circumstances
meanings.exampleEn: That was an apt comparison for the situation.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu, durum için yerinde bir karşılaştırmaydı.

meanings.en: likely or inclined to do something
meanings.exampleEn: He is apt to forget his keys when he's in a hurry.
meanings.exampleTr: Acelesi olduğunda anahtarlarını unutmaya yatkındır.

meanings.en: land that is suitable for growing crops
meanings.exampleEn: Much of the country's arable land is used for growing wheat.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülkenin ekilebilir arazisinin çoğu buğday yetiştirmek için kullanılıyor.

meanings.en: based on random choice or personal whim rather than any reason or system
meanings.exampleEn: The decision seemed completely arbitrary and unfair.
meanings.exampleTr: Karar tamamen keyfi ve adaletsiz görünüyordu.

meanings.en: involving a lot of difficult effort and energy
meanings.exampleEn: The climb to the summit was long and arduous.
meanings.exampleTr: Zirveye tırmanış uzun ve zorluydu.

meanings.tr: tartışmasız denebilir ki, muhtemelen, iddia edilebilir
meanings.en: used when stating an opinion that you believe can be supported with reasons
meanings.exampleEn: She is arguably the best player in the team.
meanings.exampleTr: Tartışmasız denebilir ki takımdaki en iyi oyuncu odur.

meanings.en: the state of being very dry, with little or no rain
meanings.exampleEn: The aridity of the region makes farming almost impossible.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölgenin kuraklığı tarımı neredeyse imkânsız kılıyor.

meanings.en: a formal agreement between opposing sides to stop fighting
meanings.exampleEn: The two nations signed an armistice to end the war.
meanings.exampleTr: İki ulus savaşı bitirmek için bir ateşkes imzaladı.

meanings.tr: eser, tarihi eser, insan yapımı nesne
meanings.en: an object made by a human, especially one of historical or cultural interest
meanings.exampleEn: The museum displayed ancient artefacts from the Roman era.
meanings.exampleTr: Müze, Roma döneminden kalma antik eserleri sergiledi.

meanings.en: not straight or level; crooked
meanings.exampleEn: The picture on the wall was hanging askew.
meanings.exampleTr: Duvardaki resim eğri bir şekilde asılıydı.

meanings.en: to die or cause someone to die from lack of oxygen; to suffocate
meanings.exampleEn: The victims were asphyxiated by smoke from the fire.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurbanlar yangından çıkan dumanla havasızlıktan boğuldu.

meanings.en: a person who physically attacks another
meanings.exampleEn: The victim could not identify her assailant.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurban saldırganını teşhis edemedi.

meanings.en: official agreement or approval
meanings.exampleEn: The proposal was passed with the assent of all members.
meanings.exampleTr: Öneri tüm üyelerin onayıyla kabul edildi.

meanings.en: to agree to or approve of something
meanings.exampleEn: She assented to the terms of the contract.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşmenin şartlarına razı oldu.

meanings.en: constant and careful effort; diligence
meanings.exampleEn: She completed the research with remarkable assiduity.
meanings.exampleTr: Araştırmayı olağanüstü bir gayretle tamamladı.

meanings.en: for a long time and in great detail
meanings.exampleEn: He spoke at length about his travels in Asia.
meanings.exampleTr: Asya'daki seyahatlerinden uzun uzadıya bahsetti.

meanings.en: after a long time; finally
meanings.exampleEn: At length, they reached an agreement.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonunda bir anlaşmaya vardılar.

meanings.en: in a situation where something bad could happen; in danger
meanings.exampleEn: Thousands of jobs are at risk if the factory closes.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika kapanırsa binlerce iş tehlikede.

meanings.en: clothing designed to be worn for sports or physical exercise
meanings.exampleEn: The store sells a wide range of athletic wear for runners.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağaza koşucular için geniş bir spor giyim yelpazesi satıyor.

meanings.en: the quality of paying careful attention to someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: The waiter's attentiveness made the meal even more enjoyable.
meanings.exampleTr: Garsonun ilgisi yemeği daha da keyifli hale getirdi.

meanings.en: showing a willingness to take bold risks; daring
meanings.exampleEn: It was an audacious plan that no one thought would succeed.
meanings.exampleTr: Kimsenin başaracağını düşünmediği cüretkâr bir plandı.

meanings.en: very plain and simple, without any decoration or comfort
meanings.exampleEn: The monks lived in an austere room with only a bed and a chair.
meanings.exampleTr: Keşişler sadece bir yatak ve sandalyeden oluşan sade bir odada yaşıyordu.

meanings.en: severe or strict in manner or attitude
meanings.exampleEn: The headmaster had an austere and forbidding manner.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdürün sert ve ürkütücü bir tavrı vardı.

meanings.en: to prove that something is genuine, real, or true
meanings.exampleEn: Experts were called in to authenticate the signature.
meanings.exampleTr: İmzanın gerçekliğini doğrulamak için uzmanlar çağrıldı.

meanings.en: the process of proving that something is genuine, real, or true
meanings.exampleEn: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security.
meanings.exampleTr: İki faktörlü kimlik doğrulama ekstra bir güvenlik katmanı ekler.

meanings.en: the quality of being genuine, real, or true
meanings.exampleEn: There is some doubt about the authenticity of the document.
meanings.exampleTr: Belgenin gerçekliği konusunda bazı şüpheler var.

meanings.en: official permission for something to happen, or the act of giving it
meanings.exampleEn: You need written authorization to access these files.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu dosyalara erişmek için yazılı izne ihtiyacın var.

meanings.en: a system of government in which one person has complete power
meanings.exampleEn: The country was ruled as an autocracy for decades.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke onlarca yıl bir otokrasi olarak yönetildi.

meanings.en: a ruler who has absolute power and governs without regard for others
meanings.exampleEn: The nation suffered under the rule of a ruthless autocrat.
meanings.exampleTr: Ulus, acımasız bir otokratın yönetimi altında acı çekti.

meanings.tr: otokratik, baskıcı, tek adam yönetimine dayalı
meanings.en: taking no notice of other people's wishes and demanding total obedience
meanings.exampleEn: His autocratic management style alienated many employees.
meanings.exampleTr: Otokratik yönetim tarzı birçok çalışanı kendinden uzaklaştırdı.

meanings.en: in a way that could have been prevented
meanings.exampleEn: Many of these accidents were avoidably caused by carelessness.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kazaların birçoğu dikkatsizlik yüzünden önlenebilir şekilde meydana geldi.
